# The Linux system packages the chatter-desktop Tauri crate builds against.
#
# One package per line; `#` starts a comment line. This file is the one owner
# of the list (scripts/check_ci_gate_sync.py fails if a workflow names these
# packages itself), and the apt cache key in action.yml hashes it, so editing
# the list invalidates the cache with no second place to update.
libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
libgtk-3-dev
libayatana-appindicator3-dev
librsvg2-dev
libsoup-3.0-dev
libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-dev
pkg-config
